# Cambridge Core

> Cambridge Core is Cambridge University Press's platform for peer-reviewed academic journals spanning economics, archaeology, and engineering sciences.

Cambridge Core hosts a comprehensive collection of high-impact academic journals with open-access and subscription options. The platform serves researchers, academics, and institutions across multiple disciplines including macroeconomics, archaeology, and fluid mechanics.

## Key Topics

- Cambridge Core
- Peer-reviewed journals
- Macroeconomic Dynamics
- Ancient Mesoamerica
- Journal of Fluid Mechanics

## Economics & Finance Journals

- [Macroeconomic Dynamics](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/macroeconomic-dynamics): Peer-reviewed journal featuring cutting-edge macroeconomic and monetary policy research, including work on economic dynamics and financial stability

## Archaeology & Ancient Studies Journals

- [Ancient Mesoamerica](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/ancient-mesoamerica): Peer-reviewed journal dedicated to archaeological and ethnohistorical research on Maya civilization and Mesoamerican cultures

## Engineering & Physical Sciences Journals

- [Journal of Fluid Mechanics](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/journal-of-fluid-mechanics): Open-access peer-reviewed journal publishing fundamental research in fluid mechanics and related engineering sciences
